recipes.name: * Refried beans, Tom's
recipes.description: Far better than any that come in a can! One serving = 295 g.
recipes.instructions: 1. Chop and saute onions in oil, in 12" skillet; set aside.2. Place half of bean in food processor, with jalopeno peppers, and all other ingredients except the salsa and the garlic. You may optionally hold out the chopped cilantro. Add enough of the bean cooking water to be able to process the mix until fairly smooth. Pour into skillet.3. Process the rest of the beans and half the salsa until no more than coarsely chopped. Place into skillet with rest of salsa.4. Bring quickly to a simmer. Simmer, occasional stirring for 10-15 minutes.5. Approximately 10 cups will result. Freeze some, refrigerate the rest.

recipes.name: * Thumbprint cookies - almond flour/whole wheat
recipes.description: Two cookies in one - both excellent!
recipes.instructions:
I have simplified the mixing instructions; my method works quite well.

1. Mix dry ingredients well, in a medium bowl.
2. Cream butter and sugar, mix in egg and vanilla, then applesauce - which will curdle the mixture a bit.
3. Dump the butter/sugar mixture into the flour mixture. Cut it in with a large cooking spoon, cutting from the edge to the middle, while constantly turning the bowl. Mix until just combined. Don't over-mix.
4. Put 1.5 T mounds of dough 2" apart on cookie sheet covered with parchment paper or silicone baking sheet (or greased with butter). Make indentation in center of each dough ball big enough to hold 1/2 T jam or other filling. Fill as desired with jam.
5. Bake at 375F for 12-20 minutes - until edges brown and tops are very lightly browned. (Exact time will vary with oven, how fine your flours are, etc.)
6. Allow to cool 2 minutes on sheet before removing. Cool completely before serving. Store in air tight container to retain chewy texture. They are quite good the day after baking them.

Note: An excellent nut-cookie can be made by simply flattening the dough ball to about 5/8". Bake for 20 minutes or until edges brown and tops are very lightly browned.
ingredients: * Leavening agents, baking powder, double-acting, sodium aluminum sulfate
* Eggs, Grade A, Large, egg whole

recipes.name: * Marinara pasta sauce - quick
recipes.description: quick to make, far tastier than bottled sauces
recipes.instructions:
1. Saute onion. (I like to slightly caramelize it)
2. Add the red pepper flakes, tomato sauce, and 1/3 can of tomato paste. Mix the paste into the sauce well, with a fork. Add the rest of the paste and the chopped tomatoes. Stir together well.
3. Add all other ingredients. While stirring them in well, heat sauce just until it starts to boil. Turn off heat, cover, let sit for at least 10 minutes before eating. (It's excellent used immediately, but always better the next day!)

recipes.name: * Walnut milk
recipes.instructions:
Soak nuts in hot water for 2-5 hours, or cold water overnight. 
 
In a separate container, similarly soak the dried fruit. 
 
When soaked, discard nut water, rinse nuts and set aside. Pour dried fruit water into blender, set fruit aside. 

Add to water to make a total of 4 cups. Add nuts, fruit, and other ingredients and blend at hight speed for about 1.5 minutes. 

Stir foam in blender slowly with the blade of a rubber scraper, to reduce bubbles. 

Pour milk into 1 quart container. Pour remainder into 1/2 pint container. 

Refrigerate until used. Keeps for at least 5 days.
